Definition: to parch (through drought) i.e. (by analogy,) to desolate, destroy, kill
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be waste, lay waste, make desolate, be desolate, be in ruins; 1a) (Qal) to be waste, be desolate; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be made desolate; 1b2) desolate (participle); 1c) (Hiphil) to lay waste, make desolate; 1d) (Hophal) to be laid waste; 2) to be dry, be dried up; 2a) (Qal) to be dried, be dried up; 2b) (Pual) to be dried; 2c) (Hiphil) to dry up; 2d) (Hophal) to be dried up; 3) to attack, smite down, slay, fight
